source_noise_average: First average original three noise frames per source/method/SNR/metric, including every original failure

statistics.CI95: NumPy linear quantiles .025/.975 of directly resampled source-paired mean differences
statistics.multiplicity: Exploratory pointwise intervals; no simultaneous-significance or global winner claim
statistics.metric_sign: Raw signed method minus reference; lower DISTS/DreamSim and higher MS-SSIM are favorable

dreamsim.preprocessing: official square224 bicubic antialiased tensor geometry; original RGB floats retained, no PIL requantization or crop

failure: Preserve unknown failures; no automatic retry, dropping frames, re-rendering or branch switch
